title: Extended to the Union territory of Pondicherry Act 26 of 1968, s. 3 and Schedule and Madras (1-11-1962) vide Home Deptt.
text:
2. Extended to the Union territory of Pondicherry Act 26 of 1968, s. 3 and Schedule and Madras (1-11-1962) vide Home Deptt.

No. Goms No. 3698, dated 2[nd] November, 1962 and this Act has been extended to Go, Daman and Diu by Reg. 11 of 1963, s. 3 and
Schedule (w.e.f. 1-2-1964).
